summary: Transmute is a self-hosted file conversion utility designed to handle various formats across images, video, audio, JSON, and Excel documents. It provides a centralised interface to process media and data files directly on your own infrastructure. The software supports thousands of distinct conversion pathways.
goodFor: It suits homelab administrators who regularly need to batch-process different file formats without relying on public cloud conversion services.
watchOut: Depending on the underlying conversion libraries utilised, heavy video or audio transcoding tasks may place significant demand on your server CPU.
deployNotes: You will typically run this as a Docker container, ensuring you mount persistent storage volumes for your input and output files.
